zh.title: 紐西蘭航空787航班取消 機師舊金山中途停留涉嫌毆鬥
zh.summary: 紐西蘭航空取消舊金山-奧克蘭787航班；機師中途停留涉嫌毆鬥
body: 紐西蘭航空一班原定從舊金山國際機場飛往奧克蘭國際機場的波音787航班，因機組人員在舊金山中途停留期間涉嫌發生肢體衝突，導致航空公司無法安排可用機組而被迫取消。Simple Flying於2026年9月22日報導此事，指出航班取消直接源於機師衝突造成人力不足。
根據報導標題顯示，紐西蘭航空機師在舊金山過夜期間疑似發生爭執並動手，迫使該班787航班無法按時起飛。目前事件具體細節、涉事機師身分及後續處理均仍在調查階段，紐西蘭航空尚未發布官方說明。

en.title: Air New Zealand 787 flight canceled after alleged pilot fight during San Francisco layover
en.summary: Air New Zealand cancels San Francisco-Auckland 787 flight after alleged pilot altercation during layover
body: Air New Zealand canceled a Boeing 787 flight scheduled from San Francisco to Auckland after an alleged physical altercation between pilots during a layover in San Francisco left the airline without an available crew. Simple Flying reported on September 22, 2026 that the cancellation resulted directly from the crew shortage caused by the incident.

The report's headline states that Air New Zealand pilots allegedly fought during a San Francisco layover, forcing the 787 flight's cancellation. Specific details, the identities of the pilots involved, and any disciplinary action remain under investigation. Air New Zealand has not yet issued an official statement.

zh.title: 荷蘭皇家航空擬10月復飛杜拜等三航點
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空冬季班表；預定10月25日起復飛杜拜、利雅德與達曼
body: 荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）於2026年9月22日發布冬季班表，表示計畫自2026年10月25日起恢復飛往杜拜、利雅德與達曼的航班。該航空公司自2026年2月28日暫停飛往這三個目的地的航線。
荷航表示，確切的時刻表將取決於屆時中東地區的局勢。該公司並計畫繼續營運阿姆斯特丹與特拉維夫之間的航班，兩地航班於2026年8月25日恢復。
2026年10月至2027年3月間，荷航計畫飛往全球64個國家的164個目的地，其中歐洲境內93個，歐洲以外71個。荷航總裁兼執行長Marjan Rintel表示，將提供更廣泛的航班選擇，專注於個人服務，並持續投資於舒適度與機隊更新。

en.title: KLM plans to resume Dubai, Riyadh and Dammam flights within weeks
en.summary: KLM plans to resume Dubai, Riyadh and Dammam flights; winter schedule starts October 25
body: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines published its winter schedule on September 22, 2026, indicating it intends to resume flights to Dubai, Riyadh and Dammam from the start of the winter schedule, which begins on October 25, 2026. The airline ceased flying to the three destinations on February 28, 2026.

"The exact timetable will depend on the situation in the Middle East at that time," KLM said. Between October 2026 and March 2027, KLM plans to fly to 164 destinations worldwide in 64 countries. President and CEO Marjan Rintel said the airline is offering a wider choice of flights this winter, focusing on personal service and investing in comfort and fleet renewal.
